CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_change_user_password(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT private.has_module_access('users','change_password','web') AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.roles r ON r.id=p.role_id
 JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=p.id WHERE p.id=p_user_id
 AND (private.is_super_admin() OR (r.key<>'super_admin' AND lower(u.email)<>'annasabbas01@gmail.com'))
 )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_role_key()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select r.key from public.profiles p
 join public.roles r on r.id=p.role_id and r.active
 join auth.users u on u.id=p.id
 where p.id=auth.uid() and p.status='active'
 and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now())
 and (r.key<>'super_admin' or lower(u.email)='annasabbas01@gmail.com')
 and exists(select 1 from auth.sessions s where s.user_id=u.id
   and s.id::text=(auth.jwt()->>'session_id') and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>now()))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_effective_system_lock(p_platform platform_key)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('locked',true,'scope',l.scope,'platform',l.platform,'title',l.title,'message',l.message)
    from public.system_lock_rules l
    where not private.is_super_admin() and l.is_locked=true
      and (l.starts_at is null or l.starts_at<=now()) and (l.ends_at is null or l.ends_at>now())
      and (l.scope='global' or (l.scope='platform' and l.platform=p_platform))
    order by case when l.scope='global' then 0 else 1 end limit 1
  ),jsonb_build_object('locked',false))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(private.current_role_key()='super_admin',false)
 and exists(select 1 from auth.users u where u.id=auth.uid()
 and lower(u.email)='annasabbas01@gmail.com' and u.email_confirmed_at is not null)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.owner_portal_access()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null and private.is_super_admin() and exists (
    select 1 from auth.sessions s
    where s.user_id=auth.uid() and s.id::text=(auth.jwt()->>'session_id')
      and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>now())
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.chat_can_manage(p_conversation_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.chat_conversation_members member
    where member.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
      and member.user_id = p_user_id
      and member.left_at is null
      and member.member_role in ('owner', 'admin')
  )
  or (
    p_user_id = (select auth.uid())
    and (select private.has_module_access('chat', 'groups.create', 'web'::public.platform_key))
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.chat_is_active_member(p_conversation_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.chat_conversation_members member
    join public.profiles profile on profile.id = member.user_id and profile.status = 'active'
    where member.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
      and member.user_id = p_user_id
      and member.left_at is null
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.crm_page_key(p_module text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case p_module when 'quotations' then 'quotes' when 'warehouse' then 'picking'
 when 'master_control' then 'master' when 'settings' then 'email' else p_module end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.inventory_require_access(p_module text, p_action text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,false)
 OR coalesce(private.current_role_key(),'') NOT IN ('super_admin','admin','manager')
 OR NOT private.has_module_access(p_module,'view','web')
 OR NOT private.has_module_access(p_module,p_action,'web') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied for %.%',p_module,p_action USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_assigned_job_object(p_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when split_part(p_name,'/',1) ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    then exists(select 1 from public.job_assignments ja where ja.job_order_id=split_part(p_name,'/',1)::uuid and ja.user_id=(select auth.uid()) and ja.unassigned_at is null)
    else false end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_conversation_read(p_conversation_id uuid, p_last_message_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_target_sent_at timestamptz;
begin
  if v_actor is null
     or not (select private.has_module_access('chat', 'view', 'web'::public.platform_key))
     or not (select private.chat_is_active_member(p_conversation_id, v_actor)) then
    raise exception 'Chat read access denied' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  select message.sent_at into v_target_sent_at
  from public.chat_messages message
  where message.id = p_last_message_id and message.conversation_id = p_conversation_id;
  if v_target_sent_at is null then raise exception 'Message not found in conversation' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  update public.chat_conversation_members member
  set last_read_message_id = p_last_message_id,
      last_read_at = greatest(coalesce(member.last_read_at, v_target_sent_at), v_target_sent_at),
      updated_at = now()
  where member.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
    and member.user_id = v_actor
    and (
      member.last_read_message_id is null
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.chat_messages previous
        where previous.id = member.last_read_message_id
          and (previous.sent_at, previous.id) <= (v_target_sent_at, p_last_message_id)
      )
    );

  insert into public.chat_message_reads (message_id, user_id, read_at)
  values (p_last_message_id, v_actor, now())
  on conflict (message_id, user_id) do nothing;
end;
$function$
